entries.content: The FleshBorn are an alien race of flesh creatures that are born from the corpse or a now dead, galaxy sized, fleshy, cosmic entity.

Millions of years ago, two flesh god siblings—brother and sister—devoured galaxies, spreading disease and terror. The Heaven-sent, young gods, defeated them. The brother was killed in battle; the sister fled, vowing never to destroy again. The Heaven-sent spared her, leaving her brother's corpse to rot in space.

Years after the Brother's colossal corpse began decomposing, the first flesh creatures were born: the Gore Bride, the Apostle, and the Manifestor. Each inherited one of the Flesh God's powers—blood manipulation for the Gore Bride, flesh manipulation for the Apostle, and matter manifestation for the Manifestor. However, the Manifestor's power was weaker since it originally came from the Primordial Darkborn, not the Flesh God.

The three Fleshborn constantly fought, leading to the division of the corpse into three kingdoms: Blood, Flesh, and Manifestation. Over time, the Manifestor lost his kingdom to the Gore Bride and Apostle. Stripped of power and worshippers, he fled the corpse, barely surviving the immense pressure of its decaying flesh.

Eventually, it was discovered that the stronger a Fleshborn was, the harder it became to physically escape the corpse. Only teleportation rituals provided a way out. Resentful subjects of the Apostle devised a trap to banish him, seizing power in his absence. However, their reign was short-lived as the Gore Bride swiftly conquered the Flesh Kingdom, becoming the supreme ruler of the Flesh World.
